info.name: HustleHub+ Part 3 - Security Matrix
info.description: Part 3 security negative-test matrix. Run the 'Security Matrix' and 'Rate Limits' folders as separate cycles, each against a freshly started API process. Supply adminPassword and jwtSecret at run time only. See docs/testing/security-postman-suite.md.

item.name: Security Matrix
item.description: Run on a fresh API process with --env-var adminPassword and --env-var jwtSecret. Never exhausts a rate-limit allowance.

item.name: 01 Setup
item.description: Checks run configuration, authenticates the provisioned administrator, registers four unique accounts, captures JWTs and creates two fixture gigs.

item.name: Setup - Login Client B and Verify jwtSecret
Setup - Freelancer A Creates Gig G1
Setup - Freelancer A Creates Gig G2
02 Authentication and Forged Tokens
item.description: Missing, malformed, tampered, unsigned, wrongly signed and expired JWTs. Forged tokens are minted from Client B's real claims with CryptoJS; a correctly minted control token must be accepted.

item.name: Auth - Expired Token With Valid Signature
Auth - Tampered Role Claim Keeps Old Signature
Auth - Signed Token Without Session Version
Auth - Signed Token With Future Session Version
Auth - Signed Admin Role Claim For Client
Auth - Signed Token For Unknown User
03 Session Revocation
item.description: Logout increments the session version: every earlier token for the account is rejected, a revoked token cannot book, and a new login works.

item.name: Session - First Token Valid Before Logout
Session - Second Token Valid Before Logout
Session - Second Token Revoked By Same Logout
Session - Revoked Token Cannot Log Out Again
Session - Revoked Booking Attempt Created Nothing
04 Role Isolation
item.description: Each role is refused the routes of every other role, and public registration cannot self-assign the administrator role.

item.name: Role - Client Cannot List All Bookings
Role - Client Cannot Remove Gigs As Admin
Role - Client Cannot Read Freelancer Bookings
Role - Freelancer Cannot Read Client Bookings
Role - Admin Lists Users With Safe Fields
05 Cross-account Isolation
item.description: Client A books G1. Other clients and freelancers cannot read, modify or count records they do not own.

item.name: Isolation - Client A Reads Own Booking
Isolation - Client B Cannot Read Client A Booking
Isolation - Client B History Excludes Client A
Isolation - Freelancer A Sees Own Sale
Isolation - Freelancer B Sees No Foreign Sales
Isolation - Freelancer B Cannot Update Freelancer A Gig
Isolation - Freelancer B Cannot Delete Freelancer A Gig
Isolation - G1 Unchanged After Foreign Writes
Isolation - Freelancer B Gig List Excludes A
Isolation - Freelancer B Income Excludes A
Isolation - Freelancer A Income Includes Sale
06 Idempotency Misuse
item.description: Replayed, re-cased, altered and cross-client reuse of Client A's Idempotency-Key, plus missing, non-v4 and body-supplied keys.

item.name: Idempotency - Same Key Same Gig Replays
Idempotency - Uppercase Key Normalised To Replay
Idempotency - Same Key Different Gig Conflicts
Idempotency - Client A Has Exactly One Booking
Idempotency - Client B Has Exactly One Booking
Idempotency - Freelancer A Income Counts Two Transactions
07 Malformed Input and Safe Errors
item.description: Malformed and oversized bodies, NoSQL operator objects, smuggled update operators, prototype keys, invalid identifiers and unknown routes all return fixed messages.

item.name: Errors - NoSQL Operator In Login Email
Errors - NoSQL Operator In Gig Title
Errors - NoSQL Operator In Gig Price
Errors - Update Operator Smuggled In Gig Body
Errors - Prototype Key In Gig Body
Errors - G1 Unchanged After Injection Attempts
Errors - Operator Object In Gig ID Path
Errors - Invalid Admin Gig ID Path
08 Security Protections
item.description: Helmet and CSP headers on success and error responses, server-owned request IDs, CORS for trusted and untrusted origins, and markup sanitisation of gig text.

item.name: Protections - Security Headers On Error Response
Protections - Caller Request ID Not Trusted
Protections - Gig Markup Sanitised On Create
Protections - Sanitised Gig Stored Without Markup
Protections - Markup-only Title Rejected After Sanitising
Protections - Sanitisation Gig Removed By Owner
09 Cleanup
item.description: The administrator removes the fixture gigs; booking history survives the removal.

item.name: Cleanup - Booking History Survives Gig Removal
Rate Limits
item.description: Run alone on a fresh API process. Exhausts the booking, registration and login allowances, so restart the API before any other cycle.

item.name: 10 Limits Setup
item.description: Registers and signs in one unique client on a fresh API process.

item.name: 11 Booking Limiter
item.description: Rejected booking probes still spend the per-IP allowance; the limiter blocks at 10 and a forged X-Forwarded-For does not reset it.

item.name: Booking Limit - Short Key Spends Allowance
Booking Limit - NoSQL Gig ID Spends Allowance
Booking Limit - Price And Owner Override Spends Allowance
Booking Limit - Forwarded IP Cannot Bypass
12 Registration Limiter
item.description: Invalid registrations count towards the hourly allowance, so the limiter is reached without creating accounts.

item.name: Register Limit - Valid Signup Via Forwarded IP Blocked
13 Login Limiter
item.description: Five failed logins exhaust the allowance; a forged X-Forwarded-For and even the correct password are then refused.

item.name: Login Limit - Forwarded IP Cannot Bypass
Login Limit - Valid Credentials Also Blocked
